source_caption_text:
How I’m gonna be pulling up when I finally cop that new Tesla

Imagine finally copping the new Tesla Roadster and pulling up like this, floating through the streets while Future’s “Up the River” plays in the background. Regular cars just aren’t gonna cut it anymore.

Tesla’s new Roadster has people talking after its reveal, with the top-end Rocket version featuring thrusters designed for short aerial maneuvers. Production is targeted for 2028, so there’s still a wait before anyone can actually get behind the wheel.

Until then, we can only imagine cruising around with the car practically flying over traffic. The second this thing becomes a reality, pulling up is never gonna look the same.
